mainEntity.name: Should I connect email, live chat, social media, and my help desk to AI all at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Begin with a single channel and a single request category, then expand after you know where the source information and escalation path live. Connecting email, chat, social messages, billing, and a help desk at once increases the number of failure points and makes it harder to identify the cause of an error. Context: Practical rollout guidance commonly favors drafts and triage before automatic replies. Run My AI Biz’s focused implementation model supports the same controlled progression. Key factors: - channel volume - consistency of customer identity - available integrations - record-keeping needs. Practical guidance: Choose the channel with the clearest repeatable questions, test under normal and busy conditions, and preserve a record of each handoff. Add another channel only after the first one has stable outcomes and a documented fallback.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. Start with one channel and one repeatable request type, usually in draft or triage mode. Verify source data, identity matching, handoffs, and record-keeping before adding other channels or automatic replies.
